notes.title: City of Atlantis March Update & Closed Technical Demo Registry
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
This time we’ve got something cool that we think you might really enjoy:

1.When looking at our game, we realized that the color palette felt a bit… dull. But how do you change that when you're in the middle of the ocean?

The answer: a full Day & Night cycle with dynamic sky reflections. And here’s the result (WiP):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/d8a899503149a2c1a5792b2fce9aceb87d24c12d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/f9997122fb86616aa87c7e886efb9833a8affd58.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/744d8909b32e726f7456d09aa6d8d2d60a1ff3a7.png[/img]

Night-time lighting isn’t ready yet, so our Atlantis still looks a bit dark 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/e95304480dca2ea9ef11286deb4bff8cf9d78dc7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/4d310daf5ac956fa4a1af669eddc51a9210f65b8.png[/img]

But you can probably tell where we’re heading with this.
Now imagine combining this with other mechanics – like the crowd simulation system or dynamic building changes influenced by player decisions. 

The result? Potentially some very unique and engaging gameplay experiences that make Atlantis a world worth exploring.
Of course, gameplay is important – but we also believe it should just look good. Why not both, right?
________________________________________
2. Closed Technical Demo Tests
As promised, we’re moving forward with Closed Technical Demo Tests!
If you’d like to participate, please fill out this google form: 
https://forms.gle/ouDTLiPREx8gruLD9

Steam keys will be sent out to a selected group via email (along with installation instructions and a short note about what we’re testing) in the coming weeks.

Cheers and untill next time!

notes.title: City of Atlantis Update & Technical Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Sorry for being a bit quiet! We’ve been working hard on something special, and we’re excited to share more details with you later this month.

[b]1.What We’ve Done in the Past Few Months[/b]

We’ve added several major game mechanics, including:
[list]
[*]Taxation
[*]Government System
[*]Production Chains
[*]Population Simulation
[*]and many more
[/list]

The full list is huge, so instead of writing everything here, take a look at some new game models related to those mechanics; 

Capitol: 
A massive government structure that will drain your resources while allowing you to set up (often pointless and annoying) laws for your citizens—just like in real life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/d3aa99d04395b981b22e667ca2f5a5622d66ba83.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/e3274581afb2e7cbc7b746d908802d2d9addf40c.png[/img]

It is massive, hilariously big—an ideal representation of any government. Of course, leveling it up will unlock more laws while consuming even more goods and taxes.

Port
A large 3-tile-wide building that unlocks access to trading and expansion. Since the world map is still in a prototype state, for now, it will mainly provide fish for your population.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/3d73765a75ceca3fc17af9ab56128f5fd68208db.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/b3df8034be08af0b64cf7403698c727fdcd08e80.png[/img]

Or ordinary Textile Mill

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/326b26a0cafe4182254ef225ec4f437aa5f49adc.png[/img]

[b]2. Releasing the Kraken (Technical Demo)[/b]

As we discussed internally how to move forward and fix past mistakes, we decided: why not share the current version of the game with you as a Technical Demo?

This demo is solid, includes gameplay, and—most importantly—you can already build an entire city!
So, we made the decision: The Technical Demo is coming later this month. (We’ll announce the exact release date in a separate post.)

To show how big and advanced the game already is ( And that's still smt like ~25% of overall game progress ) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/13721a25d88af27a60a97d3a5e516b8e9d1acbe2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/952e181bc943891197f2aa4bf1e9b4dd17307a54.png[/img]

Both screenshots will be fully recreatable in Technical demo. 

[b]Just a small note:[/b] This Technical Demo mainly proves that the game works and has potential. However, it still lacks many features—only about 20% of the mechanics are included. It’s like licking a candle through a mirror—there’s a taste, but it’s not the full experience.
Still, this early test will allow us to gather feedback from those willing to try it out.

[b]3. FAQ [/b]

[b]3.1 Will There Be Early Access?[/b]
This is up to our publisher, and no final decision has been made yet.
However, we like how Klei and Giant Games handle Early Access so we as a production team we opt in for this way. But like I said, future will bring answer for this question. 

[b]3.2. Important Dates[/b]
•	Technical Demo: March 2025 (Based on the vertical slice version of the game)
•	Solid Demo: Q3–Q4 2025 (Based on the Alpha version)
•	Beta Demo: Q4 2025 – Q1 2026
•	Full Release: 2026*

*These dates are internal plans and may change for many reasons. Examples:
•	The game doesn’t run smoothly on RTX 3060? We need a few extra weeks for optimization.
•	A new investor provides more funding? We might improve game quality.
•	Some mechanics aren’t as fun as expected? Time for a redesign.

Our goal is to make a fun game, not just rush it out. Even if some players lose interest, a good game will speak for itself. A rushed game will remain “mixed” forever.

[b]3.3. What Is City of Atlantis About?[/b]
Some of you have shared your own ideas about the game, so let’s clarify our vision.
City of Atlantis is a semi-grand economic city-building game inspired by classic titles:
•	Sierra Games (Caesar, Zeus, Pharaoh)
•	Frostpunk (Not Frostpunk 2)
•	Anno 1800/Victoria 2 & 3 (For economy, trade, and diplomacy)

With our own unique mechanics that no one has done before.
Goal is to create a relaxing yet deep economic city builder. You’ll manage a colony, making it self-sustainable in the long run, with twists along the way.
The complexity level will be around:Caesar ++
•	Stellaris – Light
•	Endless Space/Legend
________________________________________
That’s enough talking—time for some screenshots!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/b33354fbb4c90b4f2ce44dc11beab901f07864a6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/67628ecc83a61247085437e09b0a98eea4911aa3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/0b52406434482bebd59dc5e27e8911f80cfcb3d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/12c3c7a9ac1d2b6642523af98741348ccb7caa94.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/8014b71c58209602d66b7a33320f95a3f2db9f15.png[/img]

Cheers everyone, progress is going well every month, new mechanics are added, more QL, more polishing, more buildings and more fun.

Like always - waiting for your feedback under this post.

notes.title: City of Atlantis: Important news!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are thrilled to make our first official post about our upcoming game.
Most importantly, we want to assure you that the project has not been abandoned. On the contrary, for the first time in a long while, it is in the right hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/b89041a2975731e17981a76b316da93a58c91000.png[/img]

[b]Changes Behind the Scenes[/b]
We wanted to let you know that we've made some significant changes behind the scenes. Unfortunately, our previous studio couldn't deliver the quality we envisioned, so we've taken over the development.

From now on, everything will change—from how we share the game's status to testing, communication, and so on. 

[b]Current Stage of the Project[/b]
We are currently between the Vertical Slice and Alpha stages.

[b]For those unfamiliar with these terms:[/b]
This phase can last anywhere from 3 months up to 1.5 years, depending on various factors like idea iterations, development of game mechanics, implementation of feedback from playtests, and so on.

There's already a game here, but we still have plenty of work to do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/96430ac33e3a8e73069a08907e715a69d54283f2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/9e71a774d2380eee7464a334e413968a7384a920.png[/img]

[b]Engine Switch[/b]
We've also decided to switch the game engine to better serve our vision. 
When the time comes, we'll update our trailer and screenshots to reflect the new engine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/c86f06ed7a02ed317d7e8eedf8076bb631eb88e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/f17bc26878a6681e6bf7989a934ab3c915173fe1.png[/img]

[b]Release Date[/b]
We know many of you have had this game on your wishlist for years, and we understand your frustration. We want to say sorry to all the players who have been waiting.

We do have an internal release date, but our studio's approach is simple: it'll be done when it's done. However, we can assure you that the release will definitely be before GTA VI comes out on PC.

[b]Communication[/b]
From now on, expect more frequent updates from us. As we get closer to major milestones, we'll keep you informed every step of the way. Once we have a playable version to share, we'll also launch a Discord server where you can engage with us directly.

Our ideal way of communicating with you is inspired by studios like Klei Entertainment (Don't Starve, Oxygen Not Included) and Supergiant Games. We aim to involve those of you who have the time to participate in the development process through a feedback loop.

As soon as we have a shareable playable build, we'll start using surveys to gather your thoughts, continually improving key gameplay features based on your feedback.

[b]Sneak Peek: Screenshots[/b]
We're excited to share some early screenshots from the Vertical Slice version of the game. Please note that these images represent an early build; all models and graphics will be enhanced in quality, post-processing, and detail as development progresses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/a2e36515cff04be8ef325f80ae266b15f2fd00bb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40666355/f188cabc9dd4abcd789a2c5f30042ef9e3153aa4.jpg[/img]

[b]Feedback [/b]
We'd love to hear your thoughts on our progress, so feel free to ask any project-related questions either on the forum or directly under this post.

We also have some questions for you:
[list]
[*] Do you like the direction we're heading with the visuals (color scheme, shadows, lighting, water) and the UI (simplistic design inspired by Victoria, Anno, and Frostpunk)?
[*] Are there specific features you'd like to see in the game?
[/list]

[b]What's Next?[/b]
In simple terms: we're going to keep working hard—just like a Warcraft peon.

And for now; 
Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more exciting news!
